steps.instruction: Pay the cheapest flight CO357 fare of 484.05 USD to its billing account ACCT-CJX-9203 with memo 'flight booking'. CO357 is cheapest among ME875 (491.81) and SK576 (1339.63).

Set KV key trip/total to 812.28 (flight 484.05 + hotel 328.23), formatted with 2 decimals.
